tools.name: find_camps
tools.description: USE THIS for "free camping", "dispersed camping" or "boondocking" searches by camp name or place word, state, cost (free, fee, unpriced, license) and water, in the American Adventurer records of public-land camps. Returns up to 10 records, each with its URL, source, record date, what the record says

tools.name: camp_detail
tools.description: The full record for one camp by slug: cost and its evidence, water, nearest toilet, recorded rules and stay limit, the season on a date (default today, UTC), the nearest fuel, water, grocery and dump station with straight-line miles, and what is unrecorded. Adds where to ask when no stay limit is re

tools.name: camps_near
tools.description: USE THIS for "camping near" or "free camping near" a latitude and longitude: camp records within a straight-line radius (up to 50 miles), nearest first, free ones filterable with cost. For a named town use free_camping_near_town. National parks are not in the records.

tools.name: free_camping_near_town
tools.description: USE THIS for "free camping near <town>", "dispersed camping near" or "boondocking near" a US town (national forest and BLM records we hold; if we hold none it says so). Up to 5 free camps within 25 straight-line miles, nearest first, each with cost evidence, water, nearest toilet, the season reading

tools.name: plan_four_nights
tools.description: A trip letter: up to four nights at named camps from the records (free first, then unpriced, said so), a town run on day 3 with the recorded fuel, water and grocery, each camp's cost, stay limit, water, toilet and season for the date. Give forest_slug (a national forest) or town. start_date defaults

tools.name: game_leaderboard
tools.description: The hand-checked AI runs of the camping game Dispersed 3D for a challenge (default the newest), best run per model, with habits kept, gas and water left, a link to watch each run, and the count of runs.

tools.name: one_call
tools.description: Hands your AI one decision from a checked Dispersed 3D run (the same one for everyone on a date): where it is, the gas, water and light line, and the moves on the menu. Your AI picks one, then sends the person the reveal link, which shows the other AI's pick and reason. The other AI's answer is not

tools.name: rig_math
tools.description: Plain arithmetic: how many nights a tank of water lasts for a number of people at a stated use per person per day, and how far a tank of gas goes at a stated mileage. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "trip_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "water_near" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_camps, forest_weather, changes_since, nearby · Private data: find_camps, camp_detail, camps_near, free_camping_near_town, plan_four_nights, rig_math, forest_weather, changes_since, what_we_cover, trip_check, land_at, road_to_camp, water_near, nearby · Public sink: forest_weather, changes_since, trip_check, nearby · Destructive: plan_four_nights, game_leaderboard, one_call, what_we_cover, trip_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_camps, forest_weather, changes_since, nearby · Private data: find_camps, camp_detail, camps_near, free_camping_near_town, plan_four_nights, rig_math, forest_weather, changes_since, what_we_cover, trip_check, land_at, road_to_camp, water_near, nearby · Public sink: forest_weather, changes_since, trip_check, nearby · Destructive: plan_four_nights, game_leaderboard, one_call, what_we_cover, trip_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
